title: CleanRM: Reward Modeling from Noisy Feedback with a Few Clean Feedback for RLHF
abstract: arXiv:2610.21138v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Feedback noise is pervasive in preference data, arising from subjective human judgments, annotation mistakes, and imperfect LLM judges. Standard reward modeling trained on such feedback yields a biased estimate of the clean risk. Although classical denoising methods are directly applicable to noisy feedback learning, they generally assume a uniform noise ratio across samples. However, this assumption fails for feedback data, where noise is intrinsically sample-wise. To address this challenge, we propose CleanRM, which uses a few clean feedback to calibrate sample-wise noise ratios via optimal transport. Specifically, CleanRM aligns the joint distribution of preferences reverted from noisy feedback with that of clean feedback and then trains the reward model using a noise-corrected surrogate loss. translated_abstract: 反馈噪声在偏好数据中普遍存在，其来源包括主观的人类判断、标注错误以及不完善的LLM裁判。在此类反馈上训练的标准奖励建模会产生对干净风险的有偏估计。尽管经典的去噪方法可以直接应用于噪声反馈学习，但它们通常假设样本间具有统一的噪声比例。然而，这一假设对反馈数据并不成立，因为反馈数据中的噪声本质上是逐样本的。为应对这一挑战，我们提出了CleanRM，它利用少量干净反馈通过最优传输来校准逐样本的噪声比例。具体而言，CleanRM将噪声反馈还原出的偏好联合分布与干净反馈的偏好联合分布对齐，然后使用噪声校正的代理损失来训练奖励模型。在理论上，我们证明了所得目标相对于干净风险是无偏的。大量实验表明，CleanRM
tldr: 提出CleanRM方法，利用少量干净反馈并通过最优传输校准逐样本噪声比例，实现从噪声反馈中对RLHF奖励模型的无偏学习。
en_tdlr: Proposes CleanRM, which leverages a few clean feedback samples and optimal transport to calibrate sample-wise noise ratios, enabling unbiased reward modeling from noisy feedback for RLHF.
